name: perchlight-keys
description: A free, self-hosted licence-key service on Cloudflare Workers + D1: issues keys from Stripe, Lemon Squeezy, Gumroad and itch.io, signs offline-checkable Ed25519 licence files and device leases. No cron trigger.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Required. A long random string (16+ characters), e.g. from `openssl rand -hex 32`. Protects the admin API (/api/*).

SIGNING_KEYS.description: Required. JSON {kid: base64 PKCS#8 Ed25519 private key}. Make one with `npm run keygen`; embed the printed public key in your app.

ACTIVE_KID.description: Required. The kid in SIGNING_KEYS that signs new licence files and leases.

KEY_LOOKUP_SECRET.description: Required. 32+ random characters. HMAC secret for looking keys up without storing them.

KEY_ENC_SECRET.description: Required. 32+ random characters. AES-GCM secret for the encrypted key copies used by 'resend my keys'.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Needed to email keys. A Resend (resend.com) API key; MAIL_FROM must be on a domain verified there.

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Optional. The whsec_... signing secret of your Stripe webhook endpoint (/v1/webhooks/stripe).

LEMONSQUEEZY_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Optional. The signing secret of your Lemon Squeezy webhook (/v1/webhooks/lemonsqueezy).

GUMROAD_PING_TOKEN.description: Optional. 22+ random URL-safe characters: the secret path part of your Gumroad Ping URL. Needs GUMROAD_ACCESS_TOKEN too.

GUMROAD_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Optional. A Gumroad API access token; every ping is checked by looking the sale up with it.

ITCH_API_KEY.description: Optional. An itch.io API key with the game:view:purchases scope, for the /claim/itch page.
